nodes.label: Opsyonal na booking at pagbabahagi
nodes.description: Pagkasave, Today opens and first appointment and sharing remain optional.

nodes.label: Pagpapanatili ng dating progress
nodes.description: Existing businesses do not repeat legacy exercises; completion and first-value timestamps remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Trusted context at approved tools
nodes.description: Ground answers in app context, docs, and approved tool outputs.

nodes.label: Walang hulang billing claims
nodes.description: Avoid guessed numbers, limits, and unverified billing claims.

nodes.label: Direktang route actions
nodes.description: Prioritize direct actions and plain language, with safe fallback and Help Center route for low confidence.

nodes.label: Direktang Plan and usage
nodes.description: Plan & usage shows plan, allowances, actions, and billing request history.

nodes.label: Request hindi payment
nodes.description: Billing request is not payment or fulfillment; follow statuses and effective dates.

nodes.label: Owner at read-only permissions
nodes.description: Only workspace owners request manual billing changes; existing staff viewing and read-only restrictions remain.

nodes.label: Naka-grupong settings
nodes.description: Business details, follow-ups, messaging limits, and customer descriptions have directly opened linked sections.

nodes.label: Help Center search
nodes.description: Simulan sa Help Center search gamit ang eksaktong task name.

nodes.label: Usage at workspace checks
nodes.description: Confirm active business and caps before retrying; inspect usage bars and reset date.

nodes.label: Assistant corrective route chips
nodes.description: Use Suki Assistant route chips for the correct recovery page instead of repeated refreshing.

nodes.label: Credential-gated provider smoke tests
nodes.description: Real Twilio and Resend tests are optional, skipped by default, and require SMOKE_REAL_PROVIDERS plus configured credentials.

nodes.label: Explicit approval for real sends
nodes.description: Do not run real sends without approval; commands and logs use redacted secrets.

nodes.label: Signed callback and opt-out verification
nodes.description: Production SMS checks verify segmentation, provider IDs, signed callbacks, OTP booking, STOP opt-out, and forged webhook rejection.

nodes.label: Approved Suki redesign plan
nodes.description: Romeo approved the rename and redesign on 2026-11-16 for 11 customer pages and business-only onboarding.

nodes.label: Compatibility-first Suki rename
nodes.description: The plan preserves routes, exported aliases, sessions, data, permissions, payments, and automation while renaming app and package identity.

nodes.label: RED before implementation
nodes.description: Failing tests precede source changes; final validation includes tests, types, lint, builds, governance, browser QA, and Graphify.

nodes.label: One-click daily actions
nodes.description: Acceptance requires direct desktop destinations, one-click booking entry, no intermediate booking wizard, and one-action Arrived.

nodes.label: Internal and external monitoring
nodes.description: Suki platform-admin is internal monitoring; Better Stack detects complete external outages.

nodes.label: Optional Sentry integration
nodes.description: Sentry is a future optional integration; no Sentry implementation is included.

nodes.label: Sensitive monitoring exclusions
nodes.description: Do not capture OTPs, full mobile numbers, email bodies, payment proof, or provider keys in monitoring.

nodes.label: Additive rollback discipline
nodes.description: Rollback images without deleting platform-admin tables; retain additive migrations unless confirmed problematic.

nodes.label: Exact and idempotent manual fulfillment
nodes.description: Manual payment fulfillment requires exact amounts and retrying must not duplicate credits, subscription periods, or fulfillments.

nodes.label: Founder access and tenant isolation
nodes.description: Founder can access platform-admin; normal tenant users cannot, and sensitive actions appear in audit logs.

nodes.label: Validation-stage Pro Forma Invoice
nodes.description: Payment request attachments are PRO FORMA INVOICE and are not tax invoices, official receipts, payment proof, or valid input-tax documents.

nodes.label: Billing delivery failure isolation
nodes.description: Request creation and fulfillment remain committed if billing email is skipped or fails; explicit resends create distinct attempts.
